question: L Bino Devi received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for which form of dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **L Bino Devi** is a renowned exponent of the **Manipuri** dance form.
 
• She received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for her significant contributions to the Manipuri dance.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is a prestigious award given by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi**, India's National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama.
 
• Manipuri dance is one of the **eight classical dance forms of India**, originating from the northeastern state of Manipur.
 
• The dance form is known for its **graceful movements** and is deeply rooted in the religious traditions and rituals of Manipur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi:**

 
 
• Established in 1953 by the Government of India.
 
• Aims to promote and preserve the performing arts of India.
 
• Annually honors artists with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in various categories including music, dance, and drama.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri Dance:**
 
 
• Also known as Jagoi, it is characterized by its soft and flowing movements.
 
• The dance is often performed as part of the religious festivals and rituals in Manipur.
 
• Incorporates themes from the Vaishnavism sect of Hinduism, particularly the Raslila dance dramas of Lord Krishna and Radha.
 
 
 
• **Other Classical Dances of India:**
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam:** Originates from Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Kathak:** Predominantly found in North India.
 
• **Kathakali:** A dance-drama form from Kerala.
 
• **Kuchipudi:** Originates from Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Role of Dance in Indian Culture:**
 
 
• Dances are an integral part of Indian culture and tradition.
 
• They often depict stories from mythology and folklore.
 
• Dance forms are passed down through generations, preserving the cultural heritage.
